name: Bball Destiny
summary: Bball Destiny is a text-based basketball career simulator for web browsers, iPhone and Android. The player creates a 16-year-old prospect, picks a nationality, a position and a build, then guides the career one decision at a time. The road runs from high school in the United States or a European youth league, through college or the pro ranks overseas, to the NBA draft, contracts, trades, injuries, playoff runs and retirement. Each season unfolds as written scenes whose choices move the player's ratings, health, money and reputation. A finished career is ranked on a legacy ladder and can enter a public Hall of Fame. A full career lasts 10 to 20 minutes. The game uses no real players, is free to play, needs no account, and is available in English and French.
